notes.title: Couple of fixes
notes.notes:
- Fix Settings and Credits menu not being centered on all resolutions
- Fix symbol-linked exploding tiles not unlinking themselves correctly with their linked tiles on explosion

notes.title: Elzzup is now available!
notes.notes:
Elzzup has now been fully released and is available for purchase!

I hope you'll have a fun time going through the 300 available levels in the game. :-)

The demo version of the game has also been updated to reflect the changes made to the game since the last demo update in June. It allows you to play through all of the first Tutorial level pack (60 levels), and any progress made in the demo should automatically be transferred to the full game if purchased.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

An update for the demo version of the game has been published, here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: The game should now work for all different screen resolutions
[*] Changed the way the tiles appear at the start of each level
[*] Automatic level transition, no more "Next level" popup
[*] Added Settings screen:
[list]
[*] Audio options: Disable Music/Sound and Change Music/Sound volume
[*] Graphical options: Full Screen, Borderless, Windowed mode and multi-screen support
[*] Misc options: Disable Hints popup
[/list]
[/list]

Note: Due to how settings are stored, your progression might be lost if you played the demo before the changes. Apologies for that, and it shouldn't happen again in the future.

notes.title: Elzzup Demo now available!
notes.notes:
A free demo containing the 50 first levels of the game is now available on the Store page!

Hope you enjoy it! :)
